description: A claims token that may be signed or encrypted; a signed, unencrypted JWT has a readable Base64URL header and payload plus a signature.
iss names the issuer, sub the user, aud the intended recipient, exp the expiry and nbf the earliest valid time.
An API that validates access tokens and enforces permissions without authenticating users itself.
The issuer's published public keys, which a resource server uses to verify token signatures.
The flow for apps acting for a signed-in user, where a one-time code and a proof key are exchanged for tokens.
An identity layer on OAuth 2.0 whose ID token tells the client who signed in and is not meant for the API.
The prefix Spring Security gives each scope claim entry, so courses:read becomes SCOPE_courses:read.
